title: UC-008 api hooks: migrate+send-sms CLI, /metrics, 5xx alert
notes: prometheus-net.AspNetCore 8.2.1 confirmed to restore + build clean on net10.0 under -warnaserror (0 warnings, 0 errors) — matches designer's suggested version, no bump needed. CLI helper structure: A1 logic lives in Common/Cli/CliCommands.cs (static RunMigrateAsync(TaxiDbContext, ILogger, ct) + RunSendSmsAsync(ISmsSender, to?, message?, ILogger, ct) returning bool for missing-arg guard). Program.cs intercepts are thin shells mirroring create-superadmin: `migrate` resolves TaxiDbContext + ILogger<CliCommandsMarker> and calls RunMigrateAsync; `send-sms` resolves the NOTIFICATIONS ISmsSender (Infrastructure.Notifications, config-selected real provider) + parses --to/--message via existing GetArgValue helper. CliCommandsMarker is a marker type so ILogger<T> has a stable SourceContext (static class can't be a generic type arg). Both return before app.Run(); Development-only startup auto-migrate (Program.cs ~248-260) left untouched. send-sms masks phone to last-4 and never logs the message body. A2: added prometheus-net.AspNetCore 8.2.1 to Taxi.Api.csproj; wired app.UseHttpMetrics() after UseAuthorization and app.MapMetrics("/metrics") next to the health-check Map* calls; /metrics is ANONYMOUS (no policy) — network isolation is deferred to Caddy/C2 per the cross-lane split. ALLOWLIST NOTE: /metrics does NOT appear in the OpenAPI allowlist test (SeedAndEndToEndTests.OpenApi_Document_ListsAllExpectedEndpoints) because that test reads /swagger/v1/swagger.json which only contains FastEndpoints routes under /api/v1 — MapMetrics (like MapHealthChecks) is a plain minimal-API map and is invisible to swagger. No allowlist or api.md change required; full suite (incl. that test) stays green. A3: 5xx window+ops-fleet approach = FiveHundredCounterMiddleware registered as the OUTERMOST middleware (before app.UseExceptionHandler) so it observes 500 responses AFTER next() returns (an inner placement would see next() throw and miss the handler-converted 500). FiveHundredRateAlerter is a SINGLETON (window state persists across requests) with a System.Threading.Lock guarding the count + single-fire-per-window flag; the async DB lookup + push send happen OUTSIDE the lock in a fresh scope (mirrors OfferTimeoutJob). Window = floor(UtcTicks / 60s); crossing the current window resets count+fired. WINDOW TYPE: this is a FIXED/TUMBLING calendar-minute window (deliberate), NOT a sliding/rolling one — matches the designer's operative wording 'reset at the next window' and is the right cheapest-possible-pager choice; documented as such in the class doc-comment to avoid a reviewer flag. Known trade-off: 8 errors at :55 + 8 at :05 span 60s but split across buckets and won't fire — acceptable for a cheap pager. RED DISCIPLINE: A2 was observed RED (404 before wiring MapMetrics). A1 helper+tests were written together and A3 went straight to green (RED not separately observed for A1/A3) — mitigated by positive/negative pairing: the SendCount==1/2/4 tests prove the recording push sender is genuinely wired, which makes the SendCount==0 tests (TenOrFewer, NoOpsFleet) non-vacuous. MIDDLEWARE COVERAGE: FiveHundredCounterMiddleware itself has no direct test (no real 500 is provoked, per advisor guidance to drive the alerter directly); the middleware->alerter seam and its outermost placement are verified by reasoning + the alerter unit tests, not by an HTTP-500 integration test. This is the one untested seam. Alert path is IPushSender.SendAsync(PushSubscription, PushMessage, ct) directly (NOT INotificationService — that is order-coupled) to the ops fleet's active FleetAdmin push subscriptions (Fleet.Slug == Ops:FleetSlug, default "ops", all reads IgnoreQueryFilters null-tenant). Threshold is OpsOptions.MaxServerErrorsPerMinute (default 10 → fires on the 11th). LABELED ASSUMPTION: no `ops` fleet exists in code; missing fleet OR missing FleetAdmin subscriptions → LogWarning + no-op, never throws (infra-alert failure must not cascade). Send is wrapped in try/catch(non-OCE) → Warning. Registered via builder.Services.Configure<OpsOptions>(Ops section) + AddSingleton<FiveHundredRateAlerter>. Test factory FiveHundredTestFactory swaps IPushSender for RecordingPushSender + sets Ops:FleetSlug; one factory per test (FakeTime irreversible + unique per-test slug avoids shared-container Fleet.Slug collision). Alerter driven directly (RecordServerErrorAsync x N) — no real 500s provoked. All staging limited to `git add api/src api/tests` explicit paths; docs/decisions.md was modified by the parallel infra agent (aspnet 9->10 note) and was NOT staged by me. Nothing committed. Handoff not git-added (conductor-owned state).
